title: CTE (WITH)
description: Name a sub-query to keep long queries readable.
code:
WITH paid AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS spent
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.full_name, p.spent
FROM paid p
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.spent > 1000;
